Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ayaan - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 38 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Zoya - 9 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Zoya stand near him.]

Zoya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ayaan helps Mother get up.]

Meenakshi: "And then?"

[Ayaan sneezes loudly.]

Zoya: "What a day to remember!"
